key: CAL: You're back.
en: CAL: You're back.
ja: キャル: 戻ったか。

key: Any news?
en: Any news?
ja: 何かわかったか?

key: VICTORIA: ...A doctor will come by later?
en: VICTORIA: ...A doctor will come by later?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……お医者様が後で来てくださるのね?

key: That's probably best...
en: That's probably best...
ja: それが一番いいかもしれないわ……

key: SHELLY: A d-doctor...?
en: SHELLY: A d-doctor...?
ja: シェリー: お、お医者さん……?

key: Am I sick...?
en: Am I sick...?
ja: わたし、病気なの……?

key: VICTORIA: Oh, honey-- not sick, no.
en: VICTORIA: Oh, honey-- not sick, no.
ja: ヴィクトリア: あら、ハニー――病気じゃないわよ。

key: We just want to make sure you're holding up okay.
en: We just want to make sure you're holding up okay.
ja: ただ、あなたがちゃんと大丈夫か確かめたいだけなの。

key: VICTORIA: Hm, and you have a message for her?
en: VICTORIA: Hm, and you have a message for her?
ja: ヴィクトリア: それで、彼女に伝言があるの?

key: SHELLY: ...
en: SHELLY: ...
ja: シェリー: ……

key: "Help the one who's hurt most?"
en: "Help the one who's hurt most?"
ja: 「一番傷ついている人を助けて」?

key: ...That's right.
en: ...That's right.
ja: ……そうだった。

key: What am I even c-complaining about...?
en: What am I even c-complaining about...?
ja: わたし、一体何を、な、悩んでるんだろ……?

key: Heather's the one who lost her dad...
en: Heather's the one who lost her dad...
ja: パパを失ったのは、ヘザーの方なのに……

key: I need to find her...
en: I need to find her...
ja: あの子を探しに行かなきゃ……

key: VICTORIA: Honey, no.
en: VICTORIA: Honey, no.
ja: ヴィクトリア: だめよ、ハニー。

key: What you need to do is stay right here and rest.
en: What you need to do is stay right here and rest.
ja: あなたがすべきなのは、ここにいて休むことよ。

key: SHELLY: N-no, I think--
en: SHELLY: N-no, I think--
ja: シェリー: う、ううん、わたし――

key: I think I'd rather be doing something...
en: I think I'd rather be doing something...
ja: 何かしてた方がいいと思うの……

key: Rather than sitting here and d-dwelling on it...
en: Rather than sitting here and d-dwelling on it...
ja: ここに座って、く、くよくよ考えてるより……

key: I'll-- I'll call Heather.
en: I'll-- I'll call Heather.
ja: ヘ、ヘザーを呼ぶわ。

key: We have kind of a signal...
en: We have kind of a signal...
ja: あたしたち、合図みたいなのがあって……

key: If I use my Pokémon to send an Air Slash up into the sky...
en: If I use my Pokémon to send an Air Slash up into the sky...
ja: ポケモンに「エアカッター」を空に向かって撃たせれば……

key: Um, she should come by...
en: Um, she should come by...
ja: ええと、それで来てくれるはず……

key: ...If she sees it.
en: ...If she sees it.
ja: ……見てくれれば、だけど。

key: I'll send the signal out, and then...
en: I'll send the signal out, and then...
ja: 合図を送って、それで……

key: \PN, you're a League challenger, right?
en: \PN, you're a League challenger, right?
ja: \PN、あなたはリーグの挑戦者よね?

key: Did you want to have a Gym Battle?
en: Did you want to have a Gym Battle?
ja: ジムバトル、したい?

key: CAL: You sure you're up to that?
en: CAL: You sure you're up to that?
ja: キャル: そんなことして、大丈夫なのか?

key: The last one didn't exactly go too hot.
en: The last one didn't exactly go too hot.
ja: 前回は、あんまりうまくいかなかったろ。

key: But, I guess at least \PN isn't gonna be a jerk about it.
en: But, I guess at least \PN isn't gonna be a jerk about it.
ja: まあ、少なくとも\PNがクズな真似はしねえだろうけどな。

key: SHELLY: I'm sure.
en: SHELLY: I'm sure.
ja: シェリー: 大丈夫。

key: It'll be a good d-distraction while we wait.
en: It'll be a good d-distraction while we wait.
ja: 待ってる間の、い、いい気晴らしになるもの。

key: VICTORIA: If that's really what you want...
en: VICTORIA: If that's really what you want...
ja: ヴィクトリア: それが本当にあなたの望みなら……

key: VICTORIA: Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?
en: VICTORIA: Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 無理はしないでね?

key: SHELLY: Mhm.
en: SHELLY: Mhm.
ja: シェリー: うん。

key: I'll go send the signal, and then wait in my gym.
en: I'll go send the signal, and then wait in my gym.
ja: 合図を送りに行って、それからジムで待ってるわ。

key: Just, um...
en: Just, um...
ja: だから、ええと……

key: Just come by whenever you're ready.
en: Just come by whenever you're ready.
ja: 準備ができたら、いつでも来てね。

key: VICTORIA: Poor thing...
en: VICTORIA: Poor thing...
ja: ヴィクトリア: かわいそうに……

key: She's so strong, getting through this like that.
en: She's so strong, getting through this like that.
ja: あんな風に乗り越えるなんて、あの子は本当に強いわ。

key: CAL: She's one hell of a kiddo.
en: CAL: She's one hell of a kiddo.
ja: キャル: とんでもねえガキだよ。

key: Half my age and twice as smart.
en: Half my age and twice as smart.
ja: 俺の半分の歳で、俺の倍賢いんだからな。

key: VICTORIA: How did you two meet?
en: VICTORIA: How did you two meet?
ja: ヴィクトリア: あなたたち、どうやって知り合ったの?

key: You seem like... unlikely friends.
en: You seem like... unlikely friends.
ja: なんだか……意外な組み合わせに見えるけど。

key: CAL: I was affiliated with the league in the past too.
en: CAL: I was affiliated with the league in the past too.
ja: キャル: 俺も昔、リーグに関わっててな。

key: I couldn't stand to see her being treated poorly by others,
en: I couldn't stand to see her being treated poorly by others,
ja: あいつが他の連中にひどい扱いされてるの見て、我慢できなかったんだ。

key: And it turned out she and I have more in common than I'd like to admit.
en: And it turned out she and I have more in common than I'd like to admit.
ja: それで、認めたくはねえが、あいつと俺には共通点が多いってわかってな。

key: Both of us have been overlooked and looked down on.
en: Both of us have been overlooked and looked down on.
ja: 二人とも、無視されて見下されてきた。

key: At the end of the day, I just hope she gets through it better than I did.
en: At the end of the day, I just hope she gets through it better than I did.
ja: 結局のところ、俺よりうまく乗り越えてくれりゃいいと思ってるだけさ。

key: VICTORIA: Be gentle on her, okay?
en: VICTORIA: Be gentle on her, okay?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 優しくしてあげてね?

key: If you're going to fight her, at least win on your first try.
en: If you're going to fight her, at least win on your first try.
ja: 戦うなら、せめて一発で勝ってあげて。

key: That way it's minimal stress on her...
en: That way it's minimal stress on her...
ja: その方が、あの子への負担も少なくて済むから……

key: CAIN: Oh, \PN, you made it!
en: CAIN: Oh, \PN, you made it!
ja: カイン: ああ、\PN、来てくれたんだね!

key: CAIN: I almost got arrested before, haha...
en: CAIN: I almost got arrested before, haha...
ja: カイン: さっき、危うく逮捕されるところだったよ、はは……

key: Buuut I gave him the puppy dog eyes and charmed my way out of it~
en: Buuut I gave him the puppy dog eyes and charmed my way out of it~
ja: でもまあ、上目遣いでかわいこぶって、うまく切り抜けたけどね~

key: It sounds like it was worth it!
en: It sounds like it was worth it!
ja: それだけの価値はあったみたいだね!

key: SHELLY: M-more challengers...?
en: SHELLY: M-more challengers...?
ja: シェリー: ま、また挑戦者……?

key: VICTORIA: Not if you're not up to it.
en: VICTORIA: Not if you're not up to it.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 無理なら、いいのよ。

key: We met that last guy too, and the way he treated you was far from okay.
en: We met that last guy too, and the way he treated you was far from okay.
ja: さっきの男にも会ったけど、あなたへのあの態度は、とても許せるものじゃなかったわ。

key: I'm so sorry, honey.
en: I'm so sorry, honey.
ja: 本当にごめんなさいね、ハニー。

key: Are you doing all right?
en: Are you doing all right?
ja: 大丈夫?

key: SHELLY: ...I'm--
en: SHELLY: ...I'm--
ja: シェリー: ……わたし――

key: I'm fine...
en: I'm fine...
ja: 大丈夫……

key: CAIN: She's just kinda been curled up here since.
en: CAIN: She's just kinda been curled up here since.
ja: カイン: それ以来、ずっとここで丸くなってるんだ。

key: I couldn't believe the way Fern talked to her.
en: I couldn't believe the way Fern talked to her.
ja: ファーンの彼女への口の利き方、信じられなかったよ。

key: Like the second she showed any sign of weakness, he just went all in--
en: Like the second she showed any sign of weakness, he just went all in--
ja: 少しでも弱さを見せた瞬間、あいつは容赦なく畳みかけてきて――

key: No hesitation.
en: No hesitation.
ja: 一切のためらいもなく。

key: Absolutely disgusting...
en: Absolutely disgusting...
ja: 本当に胸くそ悪い……

key: CAL: All right, I get that we're all friends here,
en: CAL: All right, I get that we're all friends here,
ja: キャル: なあ、みんな友達だってのはわかるけどよ、

key: But do we all gotta be crowding in here right now?
en: But do we all gotta be crowding in here right now?
ja: 今、全員でここに押しかける必要あるか?

key: Is this necessary?
en: Is this necessary?
ja: これ、必要か?

key: VICTORIA: Sorry, I was just concerned.
en: VICTORIA: Sorry, I was just concerned.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ごめんなさい、ただ心配で。

key: Come to think of it, why are you here, Cain?
en: Come to think of it, why are you here, Cain?
ja: そういえば、カイン、あなたはどうしてここに?

key: Were you looking to challenge her as well?
en: Were you looking to challenge her as well?
ja: あなたも彼女に挑戦しに来たの?

key: CAIN: At some point, sure.
en: CAIN: At some point, sure.
ja: カイン: いずれはね、うん。

key: But mainly, I was looking for a girl named Heather.
en: But mainly, I was looking for a girl named Heather.
ja: でも主な目的は、ヘザーって子を探しに来たんだ。

key: She said she was friends with--
en: She said she was friends with--
ja: 彼女、友達だって言ってて――

key: SHELLY: Oh no...
en: SHELLY: Oh no...
ja: シェリー: ああ、そんな……

key: No, nonono--
en: No, nonono--
ja: だめ、だめだめだめ――

key: That man, t-that was--
en: That man, t-that was--
ja: あの男、あ、あれは――

key: That was Heather's--
en: That was Heather's--
ja: あれは、ヘザーの――

key: I'm--
en: I'm--
ja: わたし――

key: I'm going to--
en: I'm going to--
ja: わたし、これから――

key: CAL: ...I'll find a rag.
en: CAL: ...I'll find a rag.
ja: キャル: ……雑巾、探してくる。

key: CAL: A lot of people have trouble with Shelly's Gym.
en: CAL: A lot of people have trouble with Shelly's Gym.
ja: キャル: シェリーのジムに苦戦する奴は多いぜ。

key: I know I did, first time she had me try it.
en: I know I did, first time she had me try it.
ja: 俺も最初にやらされたときは苦戦したしな。

key: But if you get fed up with it, there's a trick you can use.
en: But if you get fed up with it, there's a trick you can use.
ja: でも、うんざりしたなら、使える裏技がある。

key: It's hard to see, but there's a little light below each next 'correct' monitor.
en: It's hard to see, but there's a little light below each next 'correct' monitor.
ja: 見えにくいけどよ、次の「正解」のモニターの下には、小さな光があるんだ。

key: Just follow the lights.
en: Just follow the lights.
ja: その光をたどってけばいい。

key: Only works from a blank slate though.
en: Only works from a blank slate though.
ja: ただし、最初からやり直した場合しか使えねえけどな。

key: Keep your cool and be nice to her, or we're gonna have a problem.
en: Keep your cool and be nice to her, or we're gonna have a problem.
ja: 落ち着いて、あいつには優しくしろよ、じゃねえと面倒なことになるぜ。

key: CAL: Done already?
en: CAL: Done already?
ja: キャル: もう終わったのか?

key: VICTORIA: Don't just get immediately distracted!
en: VICTORIA: Don't just get immediately distracted!
ja: ヴィクトリア: すぐに気を散らさないの!

key: Meditation is about maintaining focus even when something happens in the environment around you!
en: Meditation is about maintaining focus even when something happens in the environment around you!
ja: めいそうっていうのは、周りで何が起きても集中を保つことなのよ!

key: CAL: Sure, sure...
en: CAL: Sure, sure...
ja: キャル: はいはい……

key: VICTORIA: Well, it doesn't matter now; we may as well talk.
en: VICTORIA: Well, it doesn't matter now; we may as well talk.
ja: ヴィクトリア: まあ、今は関係ないから。話しましょうか。

key: VICTORIA: I take it you won, then?
en: VICTORIA: I take it you won, then?
ja: ヴィクトリア: それじゃ、あなたが勝ったのね?

key: Congratulations!
en: Congratulations!
ja: おめでとう!

key: I'd just been teaching Cal some basic techniques for maintaining composure.
en: I'd just been teaching Cal some basic techniques for maintaining composure.
ja: ちょうどキャルに、平常心を保つ基本的な方法を教えていたところなの。

key: Seems like a lot of people get frustrated around here, haha...
en: Seems like a lot of people get frustrated around here, haha...
ja: ここら辺だと、いらいらする人が多いみたいだから、はは……

key: SIGMUND: Excuse me?
en: SIGMUND: Excuse me?
ja: シグムンド: 失礼。

key: SIGMUND: I believe I was called for?
en: SIGMUND: I believe I was called for?
ja: シグムンド: お呼びいただいたと思いますが?

key: In service to the Gym Leader. Is she present?
en: In service to the Gym Leader. Is she present?
ja: ジムリーダーの方のご用件かと。いらっしゃいますか?

key: SHELLY: S-sorry, you're looking for me?
en: SHELLY: S-sorry, you're looking for me?
ja: シェリー: す、すみません、わたしをお探しですか?

key: You're the-- the, um...
en: You're the-- the, um...
ja: あなたは、その、ええと……

key: SIGMUND: Dr. Sigmund Connal, at your beckon.
en: SIGMUND: Dr. Sigmund Connal, at your beckon.
ja: シグムンド: シグムンド・コナル医師です、お呼びに応じて参りました。

key: I specialize in children's services and mental health.
en: I specialize in children's services and mental health.
ja: 児童福祉と精神保健を専門としております。

key: SIGMUND: Do you know why I'm here today?
en: SIGMUND: Do you know why I'm here today?
ja: シグムンド: 今日、私がここに来た理由はご存じですか?

key: SHELLY: Um, because...
en: SHELLY: Um, because...
ja: シェリー: ええと、それは……

key: Because I wasn't feeling so g-great, earlier.
en: Because I wasn't feeling so g-great, earlier.
ja: さっき、あ、あんまり調子が良くなかったから。

key: There was, um...
en: There was, um...
ja: その、ええと……

key: CAL: She saw things a kid shouldn't have to see.
en: CAL: She saw things a kid shouldn't have to see.
ja: キャル: 子供が見ちゃいけないもんを見ちまったんだ。

key: And then to top it all off, some ignoramus jerk-off challenger came in here and all but spit in her face!
en: And then to top it all off, some ignoramus jerk-off challenger came in here and all but spit in her face!
ja: それに加えて、どこかの無知なクソ野郎の挑戦者が来て、こいつの顔に唾吐きかけるような真似までしやがった!

key: SIGMUND: I see.
en: SIGMUND: I see.
ja: シグムンド: なるほど。

key: I suppose you two are her parents...?
en: I suppose you two are her parents...?
ja: お二方は、彼女のご両親でしょうか……?

key: VICTORIA: W-what, he and--
en: VICTORIA: W-what, he and--
ja: ヴィクトリア: な、何、彼と――

key: VICTORIA: As if!
en: VICTORIA: As if!
ja: ヴィクトリア: まさか!

key: SIGMUND: Legal guardians, then?
en: SIGMUND: Legal guardians, then?
ja: シグムンド: では、法的な保護者ということでしょうか?

key: SHELLY: S-sir, if you will,
en: SHELLY: S-sir, if you will,
ja: シェリー: あ、あの、その、

key: I'm here with the signed consent of my parents.
en: I'm here with the signed consent of my parents.
ja: わたし、両親の署名した同意書があって、ここにいるんです。

key: They live abroad, and my brother too--
en: They live abroad, and my brother too--
ja: 両親は海外に住んでいて、お兄ちゃんも――

key: The expenses are taken care of via the League salary, and...
en: The expenses are taken care of via the League salary, and...
ja: 費用は、リーグの給料でまかなっていて、それで……

key: And, um... so it's just...
en: And, um... so it's just...
ja: それで、ええと……つまり……

key: It's, um, just me...
en: It's, um, just me...
ja: その、わたし一人、なんです……

key: SIGMUND: But in good legal and financial standing.
en: SIGMUND: But in good legal and financial standing.
ja: シグムンド: しかし、法的にも経済的にも問題はない、と。

key: To be independent at such an age is truly impressive.
en: To be independent at such an age is truly impressive.
ja: その年齢で自立しているとは、実に立派なことです。

key: SHELLY: T-thank you, sir!
en: SHELLY: T-thank you, sir!
ja: シェリー: あ、ありがとうございます!

key: It was the same for my brother, so I wanted--
en: It was the same for my brother, so I wanted--
ja: お兄ちゃんも同じだったから、それでわたし――

key: I wanted to challenge myself to... be like him...
en: I wanted to challenge myself to... be like him...
ja: お兄ちゃんみたいに……なりたくて、頑張ろうと思って……

key: SIGMUND: And then your relation is...?
en: SIGMUND: And then your relation is...?
ja: シグムンド: それで、あなたとの間柄は……?

key: CAL: Just a concerned friend.
en: CAL: Just a concerned friend.
ja: キャル: ただの、心配してる友達だよ。

key: Look, just focus on her, will you?
en: Look, just focus on her, will you?
ja: なあ、こいつのことに集中してくれねえか?

key: SIGMUND: It appears to be a peculiar friendship.
en: SIGMUND: It appears to be a peculiar friendship.
ja: シグムンド: いささか奇妙な友情のようですね。

key: SHELLY: Cal and I met through the League!
en: SHELLY: Cal and I met through the League!
ja: シェリー: キャルとは、リーグで知り合ったんです!

key: We got along and talked a lot because--
en: We got along and talked a lot because--
ja: 気が合って、色々話すようになったのは――

key: Well, because he's like me!
en: Well, because he's like me!
ja: その、彼もわたしと似てるから!

key: SIGMUND: ...In what sense, exactly?
en: SIGMUND: ...In what sense, exactly?
ja: シグムンド: ……具体的に、どのような意味で?

key: SHELLY: It was the same with his brother!
en: SHELLY: It was the same with his brother!
ja: シェリー: 彼のお兄さんとのことも、同じだったんです!

key: In both our cases, it was our reason for entering the League.
en: In both our cases, it was our reason for entering the League.
ja: わたしたち二人とも、それがリーグに入った理由で。

key: CAL: It was stupid.
en: CAL: It was stupid.
ja: キャル: くだらねえ話だよ。

key: And I already stepped out of that a while ago...
en: And I already stepped out of that a while ago...
ja: それに、俺はもうとっくにそこから抜け出してる……

key: SIGMUND: ...Ah, yes, Cal Whitaker, was it?
en: SIGMUND: ...Ah, yes, Cal Whitaker, was it?
ja: シグムンド: ……ああ、そうそう、キャル・ウィテカーでしたね?

key: Your successor is a client of mine.
en: Your successor is a client of mine.
ja: あなたの後任が、私の患者でしてね。

key: I recall hearing about the circumstances before your resignation...
en: I recall hearing about the circumstances before your resignation...
ja: あなたが辞任される前の経緯についても、伺ったことがありますよ……

key: I admit, I was quite bemused to hear that a Fire Type Gym Leader would lose to a team full of Ice Types like that...
en: I admit, I was quite bemused to hear that a Fire Type Gym Leader would lose to a team full of Ice Types like that...
ja: ほのおタイプのジムリーダーが、あんな風にこおりタイプだらけのパーティーに負けたと聞いて、正直かなり困惑したものです……

key: CAL: Hey.
en: CAL: Hey.
ja: キャル: おい。

key: Shut up.
en: Shut up.
ja: 黙れ。

key: SIGMUND: ...
en: SIGMUND: ...
ja: シグムンド: ……

key: For what purpose, I wonder?
en: For what purpose, I wonder?
ja: 一体、何のために、でしょうね?

key: Do you live in denial to yourself about the incident?
en: Do you live in denial to yourself about the incident?
ja: あの出来事を、自分自身に対して否認して生きているのですか?

key: Or are you simply embarrassed to admit failures in front of present company?
en: Or are you simply embarrassed to admit failures in front of present company?
ja: それとも、この場にいる人々の前で、失敗を認めるのが単に恥ずかしいだけですか?

key: CAL: How about you stop fucking running your mouth about shit you don't understand, chump?
en: CAL: How about you stop fucking running your mouth about shit you don't understand, chump?
